randomisation: Independent initial x/y U(-.01,.01) m from trial seed; independent scattered-patch shape/offset RNG from debris_seed; fixed deposit clusters and 120 g solid corridor. Dry nominal friction held fixed.
primary_continuous_metric: Geometric tracking RMSE over common 0<=t<30 s window (15000 measured samples), not old model/data; every trial continues to docking/abort/horizon.
secondary_endpoints: complete camera-clean AND safe AND solid retained AND settled external home
observed full mission duration/effort/work; failures retained and differing exposure explicitly reported
statistics: Run is unit of analysis; independent-seed baseline/proposed Welch t, two-sided .05, 95% Welch CI, pooled-SD Cohen d; Holm adjustment across tilt conditions. Early aborts under 30 s have unavailable primary metric, not favourable imputation. Completion Fisher exact and Wilson CI.
logging: 500 Hz CSV.xz with state, pose, reference, error, 5 actual actuator torques, panel velocity, contact/load/coverage, effort/work and safety fields. 9 significant digits, timestamp quantization <=0.5 us; numeric quantization disclosed, not synthetic data.
scope: Controlled simulation repeatability over 10/20/30 degrees, initial pose and soil-layout variation; not field reliability, calibrated PV yield, coating/structural safety or unrestricted vision/localisation.
